name: 晒太阳的阁楼窗台
brief: 奶油色阁楼里的宽窗台就是接愿位置，晒太阳、接愿、取包出发都在同一个小房间完成。
design: A tiny cozy attic under a sloping cream plaster ceiling with pale honey-oak beams. One large EAST arched window centered on far wall, a broad deep pale-wood windowsill with linen cushion at its left end and receiving dish at its right end. Two wide shallow wooden steps let a cat reach the sill, a built-in daybed under the left slope, open timber floor in center. On RIGHT adjacent wall a short open arch door leads onto a small solid rooftop departure ledge; plain oat canvas satchel on a low peg beside door. Morning sunlight from arched window left-rims chocolate fur, soft cream blue cloud view. Face closeups have lightly blurred linen curtain and pale oak edge, never dark brown behind brown ears. No clutter, no hanging ornaments. Cozy lived-in real attic, ceiling tall enough to frame halo.
near: 宽窗台铺一小块亚麻垫，主角坐在上面，胡须在旁边的小浅碟上方出现。特写以窗框、纱帘和浅木色台面作为固定背景。
wide: 地板晒太阳 → 两级木踏步 → 接愿窗台 → 右侧门边取包 → 屋外平台。一个房间能覆盖日常与出发。
appeal: 像一只被好好照顾的猫，也像一个终于拥有自己小家的年轻人。窗边打盹被愿望叫醒，容易拍出温暖与轻喜剧。
fit: 奶油墙面衬出巧克力毛，暖光呼应奶白眉点与黄色围兜；窗帘与软垫能承接踩奶、蹭脸等猫本能。
risk: 布料褶皱、窗框和小包位置需锁定；图中小包偏高，正式资产应下移到猫爪可及处。贴耳胡须目前有悬浮感，尚非动作定稿。
cost: 较低：单室、单主窗光、短路线。
use: 温柔接愿、午睡被叫醒、周末宅家。

name: 云边玻璃花房
brief: 一张石台与一条低矮步道藏在透光花房里，叶影、雨珠和猫咪的日常动作能成为画面记忆点。
design: A small real rooftop conservatory, slender sage-green painted steel frame and clear glass roof, warm ivory stone-paver floor, a continuous low pale limestone workbench along LEFT glass wall is the cat listening perch with a folded oat linen pad and tiny shallow dish. Sparse large fern planters at BACK only, one low grassy resting patch at back-right, wide uncluttered center paver path leads to a half-open glass door at RIGHT front and a solid cloud-facing terrace. Small plain canvas satchel rests on low stone shelf by door. Late morning diffuse sky light, subtle warm sun patches, very restrained raindrops at outer glass; airy palette sage/ivory/honey. Face closeups positioned against soft opaque ivory lower wall and blurred green fern so dark fur and white whisker separate. Luminous halo is not lost in roof bars: roofbars away from head. No garden tools, no flowers near face, no dense jungle.
near: 玻璃墙边的低石台作为接愿位，猫前爪搭在台边；用浅石墙与虚化绿叶衬脸，避免玻璃线条切过眼睛与耳朵。
wide: 中央石板路散步 → 左侧石台接愿 → 门边低架取包 → 玻璃门外露台。花房内留出清楚走道。
appeal: 雨珠、叶影、四足巡游能让观众感觉这里真的住着一只猫，季节变化也容易成为每集开场的小变化。
fit: 鼠尾草绿与青绿眼睛呼应，米白石台托住白爪和巧克力毛色，玻璃空间显得轻盈。
risk: 反光、玻璃格栅和植物叶片跨镜头易漂移；近景愿望胡须较淡，倾听姿态更接近抬爪，正式镜头须强化贴耳关系。
cost: 较高：玻璃反射与植物连续性较复杂。
use: 雨天守候、看叶子、季节与植物日常。

name: 风吹过的小院廊台
brief: 主角在安静小院里漫步，在廊下低台上听愿望；生活感最强，适合治愈与周末支线。

A broad low wood listening bench runs along BACK plaster wall below one small rectangular window, linen sitting pad and tiny receiving dish on its near end. One squat stepping stone connects courtyard to deck. At RIGHT a simple open wooden garden gate leads to a small solid outside departure step, light canvas satchel on low hook next to gate. Cloud glimpse beyond gate only, not clouds covering floor. Afternoon sun, cream warm gray muted teal palette. Coherent L-shaped veranda and open courtyard, uncluttered path. The listening closeups backed by cream wall and a soft blurred rectangular window edge, one soft leaf shadow across bench away from face. near: 廊下木台与软垫作为倾听点，浅灰白墙和小方窗固定在身后。树影落在台面，不抢猫脸与胡须。
wide: 石板小院 → 廊下接愿台 → 右侧院门。树下空地可供闲逛、伸懒腰或追一片叶子。
appeal: 院落和门槛能制造熟悉的生活感；小天使也会贪恋太阳、玩树影，让乐天派性格通过行为显露。
fit: 粗石与柔软猫毛形成触感对比，浅墙让棕色耳朵与头部轮廓更清楚。
risk: 本图部分近景光环略倾斜，不代表修改水平光环设定；台高与包挂点要按猫体型降低，树影方向需统一。
cost: 中等：固定院落容易复用，树影与枝叶需控制。
use: 闲逛、午后接愿、慵懒周末。

name: 圆窗树屋的听愿窝
brief: 用圆窗、弧形木台和短坡道形成一个温暖的猫咪小窝，强化主角圆润、乐天的气质。
design: A modest real timber treehouse room around one sturdy living tree, one curved pale birch wall, ONE large round porthole window centered at BACK with a deep circular alcove and broad flat sill suitable for a normal kitten. Linen cushion and shallow receiving dish occupy the flat sill, accessible by a wide low wood ramp along LEFT wall. Solid plank floor, a small woven resting basket bottom-left, visible tree trunk at far RIGHT edge of room beyond listening spot, simple rectangular open door FRONT-RIGHT leads onto a sturdy railed wood porch with cloud sea far below; plain oat canvas satchel on a low peg by door. Soft warm late-afternoon light, birch/ivory/sage palette, lively grain without clutter. Wides show entire cozy room and navigable ramp/door, closeups backed by round window's pale inner reveal and muted cloud bokeh. It must feel buildable and cozy, not mushroom fantasy, not oversized tree cathedral or elaborate spiral stairs.
near: 圆窗内侧的宽平窗台作为倾听窝，窗洞弧线衬着圆脸，坐垫与浅盘固定在窗台。近景仍留一点圆窗边缘。
wide: 小窝休息 → 左侧木踏步上窗台 → 接愿 → 从右门去树屋平台。地板与平台可拍散步和收拾。
appeal: “一个圆窗里住着一只圆脸小天使”有明确记忆点；探头、缩进窝里、沿踏步走动都适合猫的行为。

use: 窝里接愿、扒窗看天、休息与归家。
prompt:
Create ONE polished photoreal cinematic location concept sheet for an original angel-cat short drama, landscape 1536x1024, exactly FOUR equally sized panels in a 2x2 grid with thin cream gutters and small readable labels in the corners. Two WIDE SHOTS on top, two CLOSE SHOTS below. These are FOUR camera views of ONE coherent physical location, not four different rooms. Preserve the architecture, props, window/door positions and material palette between camera angles. No collage of the character model sheet, no extra panels, no architectural floorplans.
Use the supplied image ONLY as character identity reference: adorable small chocolate-and-white kitten, bright milky-white eyebrow patches, round teal-green eyes, pink nose, white paws/chest, cream-tipped fluffy question-mark tail, pale butter-yellow paw-print bib. Same exact cat in each panel, believable feline anatomy and paws, no human hands, no clothing additions. One simple horizontal warm-white luminous angel halo above its head, no halo ornaments, no coffee cup, NO WINGS in this calm receiving-wishes scene. Fur realistically detailed, cute moderately large eyes, hopeful sunny gentle expression. One cat per panel, no other people or creatures.
This is a small home-like wish-receiving haven in the sky, built from believable real-world materials, solid floors and furniture; glimpses of a distant soft cloud sea outside establish the fantasy setting without palaces or glowing machinery. Intimate cat-scale usable furniture and traversable ledges, a simple resting cushion and ONE small plain canvas satchel resting near the exit are optional working props. A single fine curved glowing WHITE CAT WHISKER, only 5-8 cm long, carries a request; it materializes just above a shallow plain receiving dish at the listening spot. It is NOT a feather, letter, thread ball, phone, screen, wand or flower. No call-center telephone, no bureaucracy, no stacks of mail, no other magic device.
Top-left label "01 WIDE / HOME": 24-28mm establishing shot showing whole room and circulation, cat small in frame naturally walking/exploring before a wish.
Top-right "02 WIDE / DEPART": reverse wide shot of SAME SPACE, show listening spot linked by a short clear route to visible exit/landing and satchel, cat preparing to leave on all four paws, not flying.
Bottom-left "03 CLOSE / ARRIVAL": 50mm medium-close at fixed listening perch showing cat head, paws and surface, eyes attending to the single fine whisker floating just above dish. Clear three-quarter face, level halo in frame, empty space for whisker to read.
Bottom-right "04 CLOSE / LISTEN": 85mm intimate three-quarter close-up AT SAME PERCH with same wall/window behind it; cat lightly raising one ordinary furry front paw with the delicate whisker near its ear, ear subtly attentive, not speaking, no human grip. Keep enough perch and blurred fixed landmarks to prove location continuity. Gentle wonder and warmth, eye/ear/whisker silhouettes readable, single motivated soft key light, natural textures. Film-set realism and physical volume, no illustration, no toy diorama, no plastic doll look, no text besides the four short labels.
LOCATION DESIGN 05: A modest real timber treehouse room around one sturdy living tree, one curved pale birch wall, ONE large round porthole window centered at BACK with a deep circular alcove and broad flat sill suitable for a normal kitten. Linen cushion and shallow receiving dish occupy the flat sill, accessible by a wide low wood ramp along LEFT wall. Solid plank floor, a small woven resting basket bottom-left, visible tree trunk at far RIGHT edge of room beyond listening spot, simple rectangular open door FRONT-RIGHT leads onto a sturdy railed wood porch with cloud sea far below; plain oat canvas satchel on a low peg by door. Soft warm late-afternoon light, birch/ivory/sage palette, lively grain without clutter. Wides show entire cozy room and navigable ramp/door, closeups backed by round window's pale inner reveal and muted cloud bokeh. It must feel buildable and cozy, not mushroom fantasy, not oversized tree cathedral or elaborate spiral stairs.
STRICT DETAIL: A single smooth thin cat-whisker filament, absolutely no feather vanes/barbs. All halos perfectly LEVEL, left and right ends equal height, independent of cat head tilt. No palace in background. Cat paws feline.
